1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for an Associate UI/UX Designer at Envision Next, and noticed you are building CRM tools for sales and operations teams that handle complex data flows.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable design systems and templates in Figma that cut turnaround times for over 100 digital and print assets, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders.

My B2B case study, Bounceless, demonstrates complex B2B workflow simplification and structured UI design, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and am ready to relocate for this role in Navi Mumbai.

Would you be open to a quick look at the Bounceless case study this week?

Ananya
